rationale: Baggage Delay under section 4 of wording 2026.1 is met: the Premium waiting period is 12 hours and the carrier report shows the bag was delivered 31h15m after arrival, and the policy has no add-ons that change this. Section 4 covers only essential clothing and toiletries, so the $112 dress is excluded because the customer bought it to avoid wearing the airline T-shirt, while underwear $27 and toiletries $47 are paid in full. Payout is $74 ($27 + $47), with no deductible on Baggage Delay and the $300 cap not reached, which is under the $1,000 approval limit in manual section 3, so no sign-off is needed.
